description: Ask ChatGPT about activity captured in your private Kioku archive. Find conversations, decisions, action items, lessons, screen text, links, and recent activity, then retrieve the surrounding evidence for a specific moment. Kioku is read-only in ChatGPT and searches only the signed-in user's archive.

defaultPrompt: What did I work on this morning?
